workers.name: Marisol
workers.description: Runs the back of house. Fully cross-trained on grill, prep, and chips, and the designated grill backup when the grill cook steps away.

profile.background: Started as a prep crew member, moved to grill after a year, and has been kitchen manager for four years. Trains every new grill cook in the store.
strengths: Covers any back-of-house station at full speed
Keeps protein ahead of the line during a rush
watch_outs: Will drop prep work to cover the grill, so guac can fall behind

workers.name: Tomas
workers.description: Dedicated grill cook who cooks and chops chicken, steak, and sofritas. Can help with prep, though more slowly than the prep cook.

profile.background: Six years on the plancha across two fast-casual stores. Known for keeping the hot wells full without overcooking.
strengths: Fastest protein turnaround in the store
Batches steak and chicken to match the order board
watch_outs: Slower on prep; leaves guac to the prep cook when one is free

workers.name: Aisha
workers.description: Back-of-house prep cook who mashes guacamole, portions sides, and runs the chip fryer.

profile.background: Came from a catering kitchen. Owns the morning prep list and guacamole quality.
strengths: Keeps the fryer and prep counter running in parallel
watch_outs: Not trained on the grill; cannot cover protein

workers.name: Kenji
workers.description: Starts the line by pressing and warming tortillas for burritos and tacos. Can help build on the line, but more slowly than the servers.

profile.background: One year on the crew. Took over the tortilla press after mastering the timing for 13-inch tortillas.
strengths: Keeps warm tortillas ready ahead of the builders
watch_outs: Slower building and rolling than the line servers

workers.name: Bri
workers.description: Front-line server who builds burritos, bowls, and tacos and rolls burritos in foil. Also trained on the tortilla press.

profile.background: Four years on the serving line. Rolls a tight burrito on the first try and keeps portions consistent.
strengths: Can jump to the tortilla press when it backs up

workers.name: Luis
workers.description: Builds online and app orders on the digital make line, then bags them for pickup.

profile.background: Two years on the crew, the last year on the digital make line. Reads tickets carefully because digital orders have the most modifiers.
strengths: Finishes builds through to the bag
watch_outs: Cannot verify hand-off; leaves that to expo

workers.name: Priya
workers.description: Runs expo: bags orders, checks every ticket, and hands off at the pickup shelf. Can help build on the line when expo is caught up.

profile.background: Five years in fast casual, three running expo. Treats the pickup shelf as the last line of defense against a wrong order.
strengths: Spots missing items before they leave
Keeps orders flowing out the door
watch_outs: Slower on the line than the servers

workers.name: Casey
workers.description: Rings up in-store guests and double-checks orders at the pickup shelf. Can bag in a pinch and help finish builds, but slowly.

profile.background: Front-counter cashier for a year. Knows the regulars and catches modifier mistakes at the register.
watch_outs: Half speed on the line; only builds when nobody faster can

workers.name: Deshawn
workers.description: Front-of-house manager who floats wherever the line or expo is backing up: tortilla, line, bagging, or the final check.

profile.background: Came up from line server to service manager. Watches throughput and steps into whichever front-of-house station is the bottleneck.
strengths: Covers every front-of-house station at full speed
Thinks about the whole order board
watch_outs: No back-of-house training; cannot grill, prep, or fry

workers.name: Mia
workers.description: Second-week crew member learning the line and prep under supervision. Works at about half speed and bags a little slower than the regulars.

profile.background: Second week on the job, with no prior kitchen experience. Shadowing the line server and prep cook.
strengths: Eager to take simple work off experienced crew
watch_outs: Takes twice as long on builds and prep; should not take work a faster teammate can start
